**Today's learning: "Microwaving food kills its nutrients"**

- **What people believe:** A microwave 'zaps' the goodness out of food, so vegetables cooked in it are less healthy than ones cooked on the stove.
- **The fact:** Harvard Health says microwaving does a better job of keeping vitamin C and other heat-sensitive nutrients, because cooking times are shorter and little water is used. Boiling is the bigger thief: nutrients leach into the cooking water.
- **How they fool you:** The scary word 'radiation' does the work. Fear-based posts and pricey 'nutrient-safe' cookware gain when you believe it. Any heat breaks down some vitamins; a short cook with a splash of water keeps the most.
- Source: https://www.health.harvard.edu/staying-healthy/microwave-cooking-and-nutrition
